summary: Version 0.11.0 is live: antipo.watch is an AI signal scanner on the 25 most traded stocks of the S&P/TSX 60, with indicators computed by code from Yahoo Finance daily bars, signal files written by Claude and checked by code, and a track record. The first signals (session Nov 20) were written by hand in the session: 26 signals, none strong. The IPO page moved to /ant. The deployment froze the 256 MB machine about 12 minutes; it was stopped and started and the build retried with uv's concurrency limited. The scheduled run is not created: it needs GitHub connected to the owner's Claude account. CDRs were dropped: Yahoo gives them no history.
delivered: VISION.md approved by the owner; loops/010-mission.md.
src/ipo_monitor/scan/: bars, indicators, universe, signals, track, board, watch, render, CLI (dossier, check).
Routes: / scanner, /ant IPO page, /scan/dossier.json; health 'scan' block.
tests/test_scan.py, tests/e2e/test_scanner.py, fixtures of 61 real Yahoo answers.
decisions: Confirmed: Claude judges in a scheduled run (owner 'c'est toi'); signals public; ANT into the scanner; CAD stocks; the vision.
Confirmed (owner 'Go'): signal files reach production through the public repository (D-041).
Proposed: universe rule, five levels, run time, the plain Yahoo client name (D-040, D-043).
Deviation: CDRs out (no history at Yahoo).
